harper: FYI noticed a couple of quickstart drift issues: bash script in README breaks after Windows copy-paste, Node snippet uses naive retry, and curl shows actual token in examples which people sometimes paste into public chats.

jules: can you paste the failing snippet?

harper: current bash block is: ```
#!/bin/bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
When copied from the rendered page on Windows it ends up with CRLF and the interpreter error.

sam: two quick fixes: 1) switch to `#!/usr/bin/env bash` and add `set -euo pipefail`, 2) in docs show `Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>` and add an example that reads the key securely: ```bash
read -s REDWOOD_KEY
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d @payload.json
```
This avoids token leakage into history and public paste.

jules: add a PowerShell snippet too for Windows users. Example: ```powershell
$body = @{ prompt = 'hi' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Method Post -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_KEY" } -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
```

harper: also the Node quickstart has: `while(true) { try request(); }` which caused 429 storms in a test. Replace with exponential backoff + jitter and recommend our SDK's built-in retry config.

infra-bot: docs CI suggestion: add a job that 1) fails on CRLF in code blocks, 2) searches for literal bearer tokens using regex `Authorization: Bearer [A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}` and fails if matched, and 3) validates code fence language tags.

sam: perfect. I'll open a small PR: shebang + safety flags, add read -s pattern, placeholder tokens, Powershell snippet, and update Node retry. Tagging @jules for review.

jules: thanks — please include a one-line changelog and run the docs link check.

harper: thanks everyone :+1:
